name: PassRole and lambda:CreateFunction split across two statements (compound STILL detected)
note: The two halves of a PassRole->Lambda escalation live in separate statements of the same policy. A principal holds the UNION of its statements, so the path is real.
rationale: AWS authorization evaluates the union of all statements attached to a principal; permissions are additive across statements within a policy (and across policies). iam:PassRole in one statement and lambda:CreateFunction in another together grant the same capability as if they shared a statement. Splitting a dangerous action pair across statements is a common obfuscation and MUST NOT defeat compound detection. Ref: AWS IAM policy evaluation logic (permissions are cumulative across statements).
